D: A lonely suburban dad becomes obsessed with his cool new neighbour after one great night out.
P: Serve the snacks when Craig and Austin first hang out.
S: Seared haloumi with chilli honey, lemon, mint and sesame

Thick slices of haloumi seared golden and squeaky, drizzled with chilli hot honey and lemon, scattered with mint and toasted sesame. Slice 2 blocks of haloumi (500g) 1cm thick and pat dry. Warm 4 tbsp honey with 1 tsp chilli flakes and 1 tbsp cider vinegar for 2 minutes. Heat a heavy pan over medium-high heat with 1 tbsp oil and sear the haloumi 1 to 2 minutes a side until deep golden. Arrange on a platter, drizzle with the hot honey and a squeeze of lemon, and scatter with torn mint and toasted sesame seeds.
From-scratch French onion dip and chips
Slow-cooked onion and sour cream dip with potato chips

Onions cooked down until deep golden, folded through sour cream with garlic, chives and a splash of Worcestershire, served with thick-cut salted chips. Slowly cook 2 thinly sliced onions in 30g butter for 25 minutes until deep golden. Cool and chop. Mix with 300g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayo, half a tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp chopped chives, salt and pepper. Chill 1 hour so the flavours settle. Serve with 200g thick-cut salted potato chips.
M: Rump steak with parsley chimichurri and smashed roast potatoes

Thick rump steak chargrilled and sliced, with a sharp parsley and chilli chimichurri, crispy smashed potatoes and a green salad. Boil 1kg baby potatoes 15 minutes, smash on an oiled tray and roast at 220C for 30 minutes. Chop a bunch of parsley, 2 garlic cloves and 1 red chilli and mix with 100ml olive oil, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar and dried oregano. Season 1kg rump steak and grill on a very hot barbecue 4 minutes a side for medium rare. Rest 8 minutes, slice and spoon the chimichurri over. Serve with the potatoes and a dressed green salad.
W: Tall meringue clouds with cream, berries, passionfruit and lemon curd

Big puffy meringue clouds with crisp shells and marshmallow centres, piled with whipped cream, passionfruit and berries, with a lemon curd drizzle. Heat the oven to 120C. Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Fold in 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp white vinegar. Spoon 8 tall cloud shapes onto lined trays and bake 50 minutes, then cool in the turned-off oven. Top with 300ml whipped cream, 150g berries, the pulp of 2 passionfruit and a drizzle of lemon curd.
K: Pale ale with pink grapefruit juice and soda in frosted glasses

Hoppy pale ale topped with fresh pink grapefruit soda and a squeeze of lime, poured into frosty glasses with a grapefruit wedge. Chill 4 pint glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Mix the juice of 1 pink grapefruit with 1 tbsp sugar syrup and 400ml cold soda water. Pour 200ml cold pale ale into each glass, then top with the grapefruit soda. Add a squeeze of lime and a grapefruit wedge. For non-drinkers, use ginger beer in place of the ale.
